item.description: The skill's new "When to do Saga work" section, echoed in the README and changelog: Saga work belongs to the moment a pull request is created or updated.
item.label: Create or update the PR

item.description: The fast path's refresh step, the common workflow's reconcile step, and the integration closeout now name the PR update as their moment, not every commit or session.
item.label: Saga work, all together

item.description: The help overview's review steps and init's next steps add one sentence each: do this when the PR is created or updated.
item.label: help and init say the same

item.body: You might expect the Saga to track every commit. It now lags the branch between PR updates and catches up all at once, so a mid-branch deck is incomplete by design, which saves each session the upkeep.
item.description: Why a deck behind its branch is expected, not a defect.
item.label: The deck may lag the branch

slide.takeaway: Coding sessions stay about the code; the review deck, coverage, reconcile, and repins all happen together when the PR is created or updated, or when the user asks directly.
slide.title: Saga work waits for the PR
